“Let’s all calm down. This marriage is nothing more than a deal—mutual benefit, no strings. Once he rises to greatness, I’ll accept the divorce scroll and quietly disappear.”
What she never expected… was that this man would actually succeed.
When the once-dismissed scion ascends the imperial throne, claiming the Dragon Seat as Emperor, Su Luoyun—knowing herself to be the shame of the Eastern Palace—doesn’t wait to be condemned. She hurriedly packs her silver notes and belongings, planning to fake her death and abdicate her place.
But before she can sneak past the palace gates, under a moonlit sky, a man clad in the princely python-robe stands before her—sword brows, icy gaze—blocking her escape.
Su Luoyun, with careful restraint, offers:
“We were husband and wife, if not in love then at least in shared fate. If His Highness insists on washing away past disgrace… could you at least let me die with some dignity?”
Han Linfeng’s smile chills to the bone:
“Su Luoyun, your eyes may be blind—but is your heart blind too?”
—
Quick Intro:
A marriage of convenience.
The heroine marries above her station, convinced she’s a frog clinging to a swan. All she wants is to be dismissed and bloom alone. Unfortunately, the hero is an expert at boiling frogs in sweet, slow-burning sugar water.
(She loses her sight unexpectedly, but will regain it later. Early parts lean slightly toward domestic intrigue. Read as suits your taste!)

126005.synopsis:
Tens of thousands of years ago, the human race in the Floating Cloud Mountain Range was weak, and their territory was gradually encroached upon by the Demon Clan. Later, there were disturbances caused by demon beasts and rampant activities of the Demonic Path, causing great suffering for ordinary people and cultivators alike.
In this perilous Cultivation World, observe how a small cultivation family on Fallen Ox Mountain rises from obscurity to the very pinnacle of the cultivation world, step by step!
—
Many years later,
Patriarch, someone from the Song Clan has reached Foundation Establishment…
Don’t panic. His spiritual root is ordinary. He only succeeded through sheer luck.
—
Many years later,
Sect Leader, someone from the Song Clan has reached Core Formation…
Hmph! That Song Clan brat may have had some good fortune, but his cultivation talent is mediocre. His success in Core Formation was merely a fluke. No need for such a fuss.
—
Many years later,
Ancestor, that Song Clan brat has broken through…
What do you mean “brat”? Impudent! From now on, address him as Ancestor Song…

135733.synopsis:
As the saying goes, where there are many people, there is much drama. The household of Zhou, the Chief Secretary of the Privy Council in Bianjing, was no exception. Setting aside the conflicts among his wives and concubines, he had four daughters—both legitimate and illegitimate—who were particularly fond of rivalry and competition.
The eldest was a scheming beauty, the second a petite but fiery-tempered young lady, the third fiercely ambitious, and the fourth—well, she seemed like a time-traveling “wolf in sheep’s clothing,” possibly even a fellow modern-day soul.
Jin Niang, a lowly seamstress maid, had always thought she could quietly mind her needlework in the sewing room, far removed from the ladies’ squabbles. But when the imperial exam results were announced, bringing forth a crop of handsome, young scholars, Lord Zhou began rubbing his hands in anticipation of snatching a son-in-law from the new graduates. Suddenly, the young ladies started primping and preening, and even the humble sewing maids became hot commodities.
Especially Jin Niang, whose exceptional needlework made her the center of attention—and manipulation. Faced with the eldest miss’s veiled promises of a bright future, the second miss’s blatant threats, the third miss’s covert overtures, and the fourth miss’s seemingly genuine kindness, Jin Niang could only clasp her hands in supplication: “Young mistresses, I beg you—spare me.”
A few notes for readers:
1. This is a slow-burn, slice-of-life story with light domestic intrigue and a focus on business ventures. Set in a fictional “Northern Song” dynasty (not historically accurate), it borrows Song-era aesthetics but prioritizes plot over historical fidelity. Please don’t overanalyze the details.
2. The male lead is a younger “black lotus” (ruthlessly sweet)—devoted only to the female lead.
3. The time-traveling character isn’t villainized; her conflicts stem from cultural misunderstandings.

137013.synopsis:
Chloe had secretly liked her childhood friend Dante for a long time, and she confided her worries about her unrequited love to her dorm roommate, Chacha.
Chacha, known for her clumsy mistakes and as a ‘genius pill-popper,’ handed her a suspicious-looking pink potion.
“It’s a love potion. The effect lasts exactly one week.”
To gain a week of love, Chloe put the potion in Dante’s teacup, but after getting caught, she ended up switching the cups.
Her body, after drinking the potion, heated up in a way she hadn’t expected….
Chacha, you said it was a love potion? You switched the potion!

140085.synopsis:
The virtual reality game “Blood Planet.”
Right now, I’ve somehow ended up partnered with a “Psychic” named “ShutUp” as his “Guide.” But… was it really a good idea to team up with this guy?
The moment I logged into the game today, ShutUp came running over. Before I could even say hello, he grabbed both of my cheeks, s**ked on my lower lip until it went numb, and then did the same with the upper one. Between my tightly pressed lips, his damn tongue forced its way in.
“Hey, stop! Mmph!”
No matter how hard I slapped his back, the bastard didn’t budge.
Beep—
My Guide Gauge (GG) kept climbing, while his Psychic Gauge (PG) kept dropping.
In Blood Planet, the gauges were adjusted through physical contact between players in the game. When either the GG or PG reached full capacity, the player would enter “Faint Mode.” Psychics couldn’t log in for about three days, and Guides for about one.
Of course, there were paid items that could cancel Faint Mode—but they were expensive. Maybe because of the level difference between ShutUp and me, our gauges filled and dropped at completely different speeds.
When his PG dropped from 90% to around 60%, my GG shot up from 0% to over 80% in an instant. Beep— The warning tone blared as the screen edges flashed red, signaling danger.
My gauge was about to hit the limit. I hit his back again, more urgently this time, but the bastard didn’t let go—intent on filling my GG completely.
Our lips were locked so tightly it felt like he was drinking up all my breath. His tongue twisted around mine one last time before he finally pulled away with a wet pop. I gasped for air and checked—my GG was barely at 1%.
“…Hey, you selfish bastard! What the hell! My GG’s about to—ha, I—I’m gonna faint. Damn it…”
“Oh, really?”
Then, ShutUp leaned down, cupped my face again as I struggled to catch my breath, and pressed a light kiss to my lips.
“See you.”
The screen changed, returning me to the character selection screen.
“Ah!! You!! Bastard!!”
ShutUp was getting revenge on me.
I never should’ve played this game.

152629.synopsis:
“I want to stop this one-sided love now.”
The younger version of me said that.
After ten whole years of unrequited love, wasn’t it time to give up?
With a pained and exhausted face, I told you I would let you go.
In that farewell where I said I was sorry for everything until now, how did you feel?
“Cha Dong-hee. Stop f*cking around.”
Of course.
Whatever I say, to you it’s just a cheap trick to get your attention, nothing more than a pathetic bluff.
My worn-out heart had already given up hope long ago.
No matter how hard I tried, you never saw my sincerity, and now I just wanted to live for myself.
“I’ll tell the adults about breaking off the engagement.”
That was the moment Park Yeon-jun’s eyes changed completely.
“…Are you seriously messing with me right now?”
***
A man is crying.
But the reality, sadder than his tears, was simply the fact that I didn’t even know who this person was.
“Excuse me, have we ever met before?”
The man collapsed as if the ground had disappeared beneath him, falling from hope into despair, from resentment into regret.

155189.synopsis:
He struggled for 30 years in another world, reaching the pinnacle with psychokinesis.  
Then, he regressed 33 years back to his days as a civil servant hunter.

155445.synopsis:
I opened my eyes to find myself reborn as a dragon.
Inside the nest where the law of the jungle prevails, as the weakest and most insignificant dragon hatchling.
To survive, I must escape the nest safely!
…or so I thought.
“If you show even the slightest sign of aggression or attempt to harm a human, I will kill you. Do you agree?”
Discovered by Kaelus, a dragon knight and duke who despises dragons, I was marked as a dangerous specimen.
So now, the only option left was…
“Yip! Yip!”
The desperate, pitiful little puppy strategy!
And so began conditional confinement… no, cohabitation.
I was just acting cute to win his favor,
“Do you like it?”
“……My chest?”
“That too. And how you feel about me.”
Somehow, it seems Kaelus has come to like me!
*
“Kremlis.”
The voice calling out was familiar.
My instincts sounded an alarm. I forced my stiff neck to turn.
“……!”
I recognized him immediately.
There couldn’t be two faces that beautiful in the world.
It was him. The man who tried to kill me off that cliff.
His dark gray eyes glowed vividly even in the darkness. He skillfully parried the blade and thrust his sword into the opponent’s chest.
The man who swung his sword to wipe away the blood turned his head around.
Our eyes met.
“…….”
That day.
The premonition I felt on the cliff was shining even more intensely than before.
It was ‘fate’.

163125.synopsis:
[Sword & Magic] [Fantasy Adventure] [No System] [Shura Field] [Dragons & Epic] 
“How many steps does it take to raise a BOSS?”
“First, we need to find a young cub with extraordinary talent and no one to rely on.”
“Then, give her endless warmth and care.”
“Finally, die in front of her.”
“Oh ho! Nice! I like this one—this is interesting!”
Some time later—
“Holy sh*t! You never told me I’d transmigrate into the game after clearing it! Is it still too late to start over now?”
P.S. The synopsis is limited. A little over a hundred words can’t possibly cover a story that’s planned to span several million words. The Shura Field is just one of the tags. If you can’t stand seeing that tag appear alongside other elements, proceed with caution.

187957.synopsis:
Lu Li transmigrated into a cultivation world and became a lowly mining s*ave in a demonic sect.
Without a system or an old master guiding him, he originally thought he would have to walk the path of mortal cultivation step by step.
But then he discovered that he possessed a Twin Fish Jade Pendant capable of connecting to China…
“Commander, I request permission to hand over an ownerless cultivation world to the nation!”
“This realm is rich in resources and overflowing with spiritual energy. Recommendation: immediate acquisition.”
The moment the news broke, the entire country was shaken. The highest council convened an emergency overnight meeting.
“Approved! Establish the Interdimensional Command Bureau immediately. Codename: South Heavenly Gate.”
“The nation will provide unlimited resources. If necessary, even the power of absolute truth may be mobilized.”
“And now… with the strength of the entire nation, support Comrade Lu Li in becoming an immortal first!”
With an entire country backing him, cultivation became absurdly easy.
Lu Li sent back basic cultivation techniques, and the nation upgraded them into the 【Rapid Breathing Cultivation Method】.
He returned samples of spirit stones, and the nation developed the 【Spirit Gathering Reactor】.
After demonstrating sword flight techniques, the nation mass-produced the 【Swarm Flying Sword Formation】.
While other geniuses relied on bitter cultivation, Lu Li relied on “Mother China.”
Meanwhile, Earth itself began undergoing earth-shaking changes without anyone realizing it.
Cultivation universities were rapidly established nationwide.
“Five Years of Cultivation, Three Years of Simulations” became mandatory across the country.
Many years later, when Lu Li finally stood at the peak of the cultivation world:
“Report! I have reached the peak of the Great Ascension Realm. Requesting authorization to execute… Nationwide Ascension!”
The reply from the Supreme Command echoed across the entire cultivation world:
“Approved! Initiate the final phase of South Heavenly Gate!”
“Let the pioneer blaze the trail. 1.4 billion compatriots are about to descend upon the stars!”
associated_names: 开局上交修仙界，国家让我先成仙

200245.synopsis:
Luo Chen transmigrates into a world ravaged by demons and monsters.
There, he discovers a heaven-defying ability:
By slaying creatures that have entered the cultivation ranks, he can harvest their lifespan.
Which means…
Doesn’t that make him effectively immortal?
Even more astonishing, the lifespan he collects can be consumed to evolve his cultivation.
His cultivation realm, cultivation techniques, and martial arts can all be deduced and upgraded without limit.
From Withering and Flourishing Art…
…to the Scripture of the Cycle of Time.
From the Adamantine Body…
…to the Kṣitigarbha Dharma Aspect of Suppressing the Infernal Prison.
Countless years pass.
Luo Chen draws his blade and faces the divine beings who rule the heavens and earth, along with the enlightened cultivators who stand at the pinnacle of the world.
Looking at the assembled powers, he smiles calmly.
“Fellow Daoists… lend me your strength.”
associated_names: 从镇魔司开始长生不死

215605.synopsis:
Lynn reincarnated as a medieval villager, right as goblins were invading his village.
Just when he thought he was doomed right from the start, he discovered that after killing a single goblin, the 《Monster Identification Manual》 appeared in his mind.
As long as he kills monsters, he can obtain corresponding Bloodline Points to unlock monster bloodlines and empower himself.
From mutated goblins and lava behemoths to chromatic dragons, he collects all kinds of monster bloodlines—unlocking a goblin’s Stealth, a slime’s Mimicry, a dragon’s breath…
Unlocking enough entries in the monster encyclopedia even grants Hextech Rune rewards.
First Rune Choice (Pick 1 of 3):
[Slacking Off: Do not participate in adventuring for three years; gain 600 Bloodline Points and 50 gold coins after three years.] 
[Burst Step: After casting a spell, dash 5 meters in any direction within 0.3 seconds without consuming stamina.] 
[Late-Game Expert: Gain 15 Free Attribute Points when your class level exceeds 12.] 
With the modest help of the 《Monster Identification Manual》, Lynn begins working hard toward his goals: becoming a long-lived species and a legendary adventurer!
associated_names: 怪物图鉴：从哥布林血脉开始

221749.synopsis:
A system’s query: How does it feel to go from a chivalrous wanderer of the rivers and lakes and transmigrate into a Prince in Kang Xi’s era?
Eighth Prince Yin Si: Grateful, I am at the Palace of Prolonging Happiness, and I just finished my homework. The food is top-notch, I gained ten kilos; the bed is super soft, I can’t get out of bed. But the fighting among my brothers and concubine-mothers are becoming increasingly fierce, I’m a little scared.
The system continued to ask: Then do you have any plans for the future?
Eighth Prince Yin Si: I am planning to study medicine properly, and preserve my small life. Let’s set a small goal first, like ensuring that half of the Capital’s inhabitants are inoculated with chicken pox.
In any case, I am staying far, far away from the Eldest Prince and the Crown Prince.
…
Later, when the Eldest Prince and the Crown Prince fell off the stage of succession, they happened to flatten a group of followers as well.
Eighth Prince patted his own chest, while showing off his own self-knowledge: Would you look at that, isn’t it better to be a divine doctor rather than fighting for the throne?
Alas, the story did not end there…
associated_names: Duo Di Bu Ru Dang Shen Yi [Qing Chuan]
